covenants.quote: For a period of twelve (12) months after termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Contractor shall not, anywhere in the world, directly or indirectly, provide any software or data services to any person, whether as an employee, consultant, contractor, partner or otherwise, in competition with the Company.
covenants.impact: The new contract includes a non-compete clause that restricts Marcus Reed from providing software or data services to any person in competition with AtliQ for 12 months post-termination. This clause directly impacts AtliQ's existing clients, Crestline Retail and ShopSwift, as they are in the same sector as the new client (Lakeshore Grocers Inc.).
